=== Possible Samuel Glasgow, London pen-cutter ===
Samuel Glasgow, pen-cutter, formerly of Shaftesbury Place, Aldersgate Street, and afterwards Webber Street, Surrey Road, is item 70 in an Amicable Society notice concerning deaths in 1794 (Old Style).<ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/32751669/ The Times, 1795-07-14, p.1].</ref><ref>[https://www.newspapers.com/image/32751719/ The Times, 1795-07-15, p.1].</ref>

The notice, headed 10 July 1795, reports a death in 1794 using the printed Old Style wording; it does not give an exact death day. It names no family and does not identify the pen-cutter with the 1761 defendant. Later American deaths are competing, differently qualified chronology, not corroboration of the London death.

This may concern [[Glasgow-1133]]. Samuel’s estimated 1745 Virginia birth permits the London death by age. His marriage to Mary Stephenson and the American family account remain competing context; they do not establish his whereabouts in 1794.
